title: An Oil Rig Drained an Entire Lake in Three Hours

scenes.text: One drill hole drained an entire lake in three hours.
In 1980, an oil rig drilled into Lake Peigneur in Louisiana.
The drill punched into a salt mine far below the water.
A giant whirlpool swallowed a tugboat, the rig and 65 acres of land.
Then salt water poured back in and made a 164 foot waterfall.
Nobody died. The lake is back, but now it is salty and 200 feet deep.

description:
In 1980 a drilling accident drained Louisiana's Lake Peigneur into a salt mine in about three hours.
It swallowed a tugboat, a rig and 65 acres of land. No people died.
Would you have fished there that day?
first_comment: A whole lake vanished down one hole. What's the strangest accident you know of?
